caveat: Measured on one developer machine against local containers, with ClickHouse sharing a 4GB VM with Kafka and PostgreSQL. Comparable to another run on the same machine; not to anything else.

projectionFill.seedNote: 50,000 Moments written to PostgreSQL in 22s by `pnpm seed:history`.
projectionFill.rebuildNote: Into an empty version, so insert-only — zero DELETEs observed, which confirms ADR-128. The cost is per-statement round trip (~42ms for inserts and selects alike), not mutation. One insert per Moment also means one part per Moment: at 5,164 rows the projection held 60 parts, and with `final: 1` on every read the merge cost grows until reads exceed the socket timeout. A rebuild of 5,000 failed that way after 1,530s having written 2,161. Batching inserts is the fix, and belongs to the projector rather than here.
